Case: Patient D is a 45-year-old White man who presents with new back pain after a fall from a ladder. The pain is focal in his lower back and does not radiate but has rapidly progressed in intensity in the few hours since the fall. You order a CT scan of the lumbar spine, which reveals a new chance fracture of the L1 vertebral body – both pedicles have been disrupted.
